assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square seamless repeatable game albedo texture for a 2m wide x 2.2m tall wall face in Depths, a gritty first-person dungeon crawler, Godot Mobile renderer. Texture only, viewed perfectly orthographically straight on, filling the complete square edge to edge. Cold wet WATER-CARVED LIMESTONE natural cave wall, broad interlocking rounded rock masses and subtle horizontal sedimentary bedding interrupted by eroded vertical seep channels. Dark cool grey and desaturated slate blue-green, sparse dirty bone-white thin calcite streaks; very sparse deep-green damp staining. Medium-low contrast, broad readable painterly material masses, crisp restrained edge definition, dark rough crevices. Natural rock, no bricks, no rectangular masonry, no timbers, no mushrooms, no plant growth silhouettes. Wetness is communicated by dark mineral stains and smooth eroded shapes, NOT painted white specular streaks or mirror reflections. This is physically neutral base colour, under evenly diffuse neutral light: no cast shadows, perspective, vignette, ambient occlusion halos, illumination gradient, torch orange, baked light sources, glossy highlights, text, symbols, frame or border. Seamless on BOTH horizontal and vertical repeat: continue geology across left/right and top/bottom borders, same average value at all edges, no isolated central feature or edge frame. Avoid fine photographic gravel noise and tiny repetitive cells. Entire texture should remain a dark grey damp natural rock wall after shrinking to a 512px game texture. Create one opaque square texture; no presentation board or labels.
assets.processing: Original PNG unchanged. Godot import limit 512, mipmaps enabled.
